name: Speed Rovers 2
subtitle: Motorcycle Racing & Bike Games
promotional_text: Chase rivals through city streets, coastal roads and alpine turns. Steer with a swipe or hold and drag, weave through traffic, and race for first place.
description:
Find your line. Catch the pack. Keep racing.

Speed Rovers 2 is a portrait motorcycle racer with responsive steering, busy roads and scenic routes. Race computer-controlled riders, weave past traffic and keep your momentum through every turn.

STEER YOUR WAY
Make a quick swipe to move sideways, or hold and drag your thumb for precise positioning between lanes. Automatic acceleration and gear changes let you focus on the road ahead.

SEVEN CHANGING ENVIRONMENTS
Ride through downtown streets, a sunset river bridge, green outskirts, a daytime city, the Italian coast, Tokyo at night and the Swiss Alps. Each stretch brings a different backdrop to the race.

RACE THROUGH THE TRAFFIC
Read the gaps, watch for oncoming vehicles and steer around roadworks and broken pavement. Contact slows you down and drops your momentum. Recover, accelerate and chase the riders ahead.

MAKE THE RIDE YOURS
Collect coins during races and use them to unlock riders and city selections. Your progress and settings are saved on your device.

HEAR THE ENGINE CLIMB
Engine pitch follows acceleration and gear changes, with wind, passing traffic and police sirens adding to the ride. Music and sound can be adjusted in Settings.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Choose the relaxed-pace option for a gentler ride. Play offline without creating an account.

Take the next gap. Race for the finish.
whats_new: Hold and drag to steer freely between lanes, with quick swipes still supported. Expanded rider and traffic poses, improved vehicle scaling, road-contact shadows and speed-linked wheel motion. Refreshed menus and race HUD.
app_review_notes:
Speed Rovers 2 is an offline, single-player motorcycle racing game. No login is required.

Tap RACE from the home screen. The bike accelerates and changes gears automatically. Swipe left or right for a lateral step, or hold and drag below the top HUD for continuous steering. Position is bounded by the road edges. Collisions reduce speed rather than immediately ending a race. The race ends at the route finish; place is shown on the HUD and results screen.

The garage/selection screens unlock additional riders and city selections using coins earned in the game. This version has no real-money in-app purchases, advertisements, subscriptions, chat or user-generated content. Settings include music, sound effects and relaxed pace.

Please review version 1.0.6, build 113. Review contact details are supplied separately in App Store Connect.
